Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “what company is the college … a part of” as seeking corporate affiliations, even inventing a non-existent “Global Academic Network,” and directed searches toward industry partners. This ignored the clear, relevant fact visible in the results that Brooklyn College is part of the City University of New York (CUNY) system, leading the workflow down an irrelevant path and to a wrong final answer.
